Definition: apparently from a form of G2300; wonder (properly concrete; but by implication, abstract):--admiration.
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses thaûma where it means a wonder. In 2 Corinthians 11:14, no marvel, for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light, and it appears again in Revelation 17:6.
TheologicalSignificance: Satan dressed as an angel of light warns me that wonder alone is no proof, and I need truth to tell marvel from mimicry.
